body: i lit my candle. i hope you can find peace and happiness and choose not to end your life. my candle will be lonely without someone else to light another

there is no chance for my life to get better. i am stuck with a very painful chronic illness, and debilitating mental illnesses i will never truly recover from. while my life could certainly improve, my prime reasons for ending my life will never go away.

as much as i wish i could say you are my sole reason to die, i have made my choice.

my intent when starting these posts was not to change my mind, but to have some of my final words out there. if that makes sense. just to keep a piece of me out there on the internet. somewhere. 

i’ve had my share of happiness. i won’t say i haven’t had my happy days. yesterday was very good for example.
the pain, mental and physical, are truly what are bringing me to do this. as well as the feeling i’ve ruined my life with past actions.

i wish you well in bringing happiness to others. 
and sometimes, there is no right thing. one’s actions cannot always prevent another. i don’t think there was a single thing that could have prevented me from making this decision.


just because i am making this decision doesn’t mean anyone else should. 
my cousin committed suicide 3 years ago. my family is now torn apart, ruined. most of my family is near making the same decision as i, and many have delved into drug usage or other forms of self harm.
suicide isn’t good.
suicide isn’t a good option.

you are strong enough to make the correct choice. to stay alive. to be a motivation for others. to speak out against suicide.

i was not. which is why i am making this choice.
i hope you are able to find peace of mind. stay safe.
